title: Hybrid light-matter excitations and spontaneous time-reversal symmetry breaking in two-dimensional Josephson Junctions
summary: In the context of hybrid superconductor-semiconductor systems, Josephson junctions based on two-dimensional materials, such as graphene, offer promising opportunities because of their scalability and gate-tunable electronic properties. In this work, we investigate the inductive coupling between a quantum LC resonator and a superconducting loop embedding a short, ballistic, planar Josephson junction, with the graphene-based case as a representative example.
